Container.Name: Satisfactory-Map-Renderer
Container.Overview:
Interactive map of your Satisfactory save game. Shows the whole factory (foundations, buildings, belts, pipes, railways, power), players, vehicles, resource nodes with purity, collectibles and more, with search and click-to-inspect.
The save game is chosen in the web UI by an admin: upload a .sav file, fetch it from a running dedicated server through its HTTPS API (game version 1.0 or newer, API token from server.GenerateAPIToken), or copy it over SSH. A "Refresh snapshot" button fetches the current state again. Visitors only see the map.
Reads saves from Update 5 up to 1.2.4. Works out of the box: the game's icons, names and in-game map (from Satisfactory 1.2.4) are included.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: satisfactory map save savegame dedicated server factory interactive

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the map is served on.

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: The rendered map, exported game data, map images and the save game source settings (including the server's API token).

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Required, at least 8 characters. Only admins who log in with it (Save game tab of the side panel) can choose or refresh the save game.

Config.Name: Game Folder
Config.Description: Optional, normally not needed. A Satisfactory installation (the folder that contains FactoryGame and CommunityResources): if your game is newer than the game data in the image, the icons, names and in-game map are exported from it once.

Config.Name: Max Zoom
Config.Description: Highest rendered zoom level, 3 to 9. 9 is the sharpest; each level less renders about four times faster and needs a quarter of the disk space.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the data path; the app runs as this user. Unraid default: 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the data path. Unraid default: 100 (users).
